page: Amazon Web Services r7a.8xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It features an AMD EPYC 9R14 processor with 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory running at 5 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or onboard GPUs, relying on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core and memory performance. The instance achieves top-tier results in prompt processing for small language models and strong performance in medium-model text generation. Multi-core CPU performance, software compilation, database operations, and Redis SET operations all rank in the top 25 percent. Memory bandwidth tests show high write speeds for large blocks and excellent read performance for cached small blocks, though uncached large block reads fall into the average tier.

Due to the lack of local NVMe storage and dedicated GPUs, this instance is not designed for local-storage-heavy databases or GPU-accelerated deep learning. However, the combination of 256 GB of DDR5 RAM, dedicated AMD EPYC cores, and strong memory bandwidth makes it highly cost-efficient for memory-intensive workloads relative to its resource density. It is well-suited for in-memory databases, Redis caching layers, enterprise applications, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
